tax.notice.changes: At filing, a balance the bank couldn't pay and no plan takes brings the IRS's bill, Notice CP14 (`billed`, from 2026-10-16), naming the due date on a return filed early. Each step accrues; CP501, CP503, CP504 and LT11 come five weeks apart, the first five weeks after the later of the due date and filing (`nextNotice`; until 2026-10-16 counted from filing, so a return filed early had CP501 and CP503 before the tax was due); the federal lien is filed at LT11 where $10,000 or more is owed. The levy comes 30 days after LT11, through drawFromBank, and takes what the accounts hold up to what's owed, again every 91 days while anything is owed; a plan pending, in force or in default stops it. A save holding a letter before its earliest day has it moved there on opening (`armCollection`).
